title: test(app-shell): an authored record:activity with enableThreading shows stored replies and offers the reply input on the record page (objectui#12249)
body:
Part of #12249

Clause-②: no

Test only. An authored record page whose only feed block is a `record:activity` declaring `enableThreading: true` already shows a stored reply under its parent and offers the reply input on a comment, on `main`. This PR adds the host-path pin for that page shape, which no existing pin covers. It changes no source.

The card stays open for the seat to decide. Its reply half is delivered on `main` by objectui#12144's change (PR objectui#12147). Its edit and delete half is declared nowhere in the UI contract (see below), so per triage it is a new card, not this one.

## Measured first

The pin `RecordDetailView.authoredActivityThreading-12249.test.tsx` (`@object-ui/app-shell`) uses the card's page shape, HotCRM's `case_detail_page`:

- a header, then a `page:tabs` whose Activity tab holds a `record:activity`;
- that block's `properties` bag is copied from HotCRM, `enableThreading: true` included;
- no `record:discussion` node anywhere on the page.

The real `RecordDetailView` renders it on `?tab=activity`, under the real `MePermissionsProvider` with a create grant on `sys_comment`. A fake data source answers the `sys_comment` and `sys_activity` reads.

- **At the card's pin `d758f2f20d`** (HotCRM 4.0.1's objectui), with this pin copied in: `Tests  5 failed | 2 passed (7)`. The two green cases are the "no `record:discussion` on the page" case and the threading-off control. The failures read `Unable to find an accessible element with the role "button" and name /1 reply/` and `Unable to find an element with the placeholder text of: Reply…`.
- **On `main` `0cd322d` plus this pin** (`629e2e3`): `Tests  7 passed (7)`.

So the card's observation reproduces through the host path at its own pin, and does not reproduce on `main`. REST compare: `d758f2f20d...a7d4920` is ahead 34 and behind 0, and `a7d4920...0cd322d` is ahead 56 and behind 0. objectui#12144's merge `a7d4920` sits between the card's pin and `main`.

## What the pin asserts (7 cases)

- The page carries no `record:discussion`. The Activity tab is the open one, and each comment body is on screen exactly once.
- A parent and one stored child: the child is not a root row, and it shows under the parent's `1 reply` toggle.
- Under a create grant on `sys_comment`, every comment row offers the reply input, the zero-reply comment included.
- A `sys_activity` row offers none.
- The first reply on a comment posts `sys_comment` with `thread_id` and `parent_id`, then shows under that comment.
- Under a read-only grant, no row offers the input, and the stored reply still shows under its parent.
- CONTROL: the same block with `enableThreading: false` lists the reply as a row of its own in read order, with no toggle and no input, under the same create grant.

## Why this pin does not duplicate objectui#12144's pins

objectui#12144's page pin renders the SYNTHESIZED default page, whose `record:discussion` goes through `record-chatter.tsx`. Its timeline pin mounts `RecordActivityTimeline` alone. Neither mounts `record:activity`, so neither reads the `record-activity.tsx` renderer's own `enableThreading` read or the `onAddReply` it forwards from the host `DiscussionContext`.

Two one-shot ablations in `record-activity.tsx` show this:

- **A1:** `onAddReply={discussion?.onAddReply as any}` becomes `onAddReply={undefined}`. This pin: `Tests  3 failed | 4 passed (7)`, the three input cases.
- **A2:** `enableThreading: read('enableThreading'),` becomes `enableThreading: undefined,`. This pin: `Tests  5 failed | 2 passed (7)`, every reply-list and input case.
- Under each mutation, the existing tests stay green:
  - the reply-path set (`RecordDetailView.replyCountOnRead-12144`, `RecordDetailView.commentWriteFailure-10899`, `RecordDetailView.discussionFallbackPipeline-8983`, `RecordActivityTimeline.zeroReplyInput-12144`, `record-activity.test.tsx`, `record-block-record-reach.test.tsx`) read `Tests  55 passed (55)`;
  - a wider set read `Test Files  46 passed (46)`, `Tests  1793 passed (1793)`. It is every test file a `git grep` finds naming `onAddReply`, `enableThreading`, `replyPlaceholder`, `Send reply`, `record:activity`, `RecordActivityRenderer` or `renderers/record-activity`, plus every `record-activity*.test.tsx`. It leaves out `packages/cli`'s two validate ratchets, which render nothing.
- The set is chosen by grep, not by running the whole suite under each mutation. It shows that these tests do not catch the ablations, not that nothing does.
- Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. It reported the anchor count `1 -> 0` and the blob change, and restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`. vitest resolves `@object-ui/plugin-detail` to `src` through the root `vitest.config.mts` alias table, so no `dist/` is in the path.

## Edit and delete: nothing in the UI contract declares them

Triage's ruling for this item says the dev first reads what the spec declares. What was searched and found:

- `RecordActivityProps` in the INSTALLED `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 has these keys, read off its runtime shape: `types, filterMode, showFilterToggle, limit, showCompleted, unifiedTimeline, showCommentInput, enableMentions, enableReactions, enableThreading, showSubscriptionToggle, aria`. There is no edit or delete key. `RecordChatterProps` (`position, width, collapsible, defaultCollapsed, feed, aria`) takes the same object as its `feed`.
- A search of the installed spec source for `allowEdit`, `allowDelete`, `enableEdit`, `enableDelete`, `editComment`, `deleteComment`, `isEdited` and `edited_at` finds only the permission, grid-field and REST-server meanings. None is about a comment.
- The data layer does hold the capability, as data and not as a UI declaration:
  - objectstack `origin/main`'s `sys_comment` object (`plugin-audit`, `sys-comment.object.ts`) carries the `is_edited` and `edited_at` lifecycle fields;
  - `comment-access-hooks.ts` lets the author update or delete a comment ("authors govern their own words"), and also a user who can edit the parent record;
  - the spec's `managedBy` doc names `sys_comment` among user-owned rows with generic Edit and Delete affordances.
- objectui already has owner-gated edit and delete in `@object-ui/collaboration`'s `CommentThread` (`onEditComment`, `onDeleteComment`, behind `isOwner`). The record page does not mount it.

So no edit or delete code is written here. These readings are for the seat to file the new card.

## Verification

All on `7a6807c`:

- Under the verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run` on this pin and both objectui#12144 pins gave `Test Files  3 passed (3)`, `Tests  20 passed (20)`.
- Dependency closure `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: `BUILD_EXIT=0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` echoed `type-check` and ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pin.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `pnpm check:phantom-deps`: all exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths answered NOT GOVERNED.
- eslint, narrowed to the one source file this diff touches (the changeset is not linted): `--format json` read 1 file, with 0 errors and 4 `no-explicit-any` warnings. The warnings are on the fake data source's `as any`, the same shape as the objectui#12144 pin. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so a new test file cannot change the verdict on an untouched file.
- Not run locally: the whole `packages/app-shell/` suite. The diff adds one test file and changes no source, so no other test's subject moved. CI's `pnpm test` runs the full suite.

## Acceptance notes

- The changeset has an empty frontmatter. The change is one test, so no package releases.
- Delivery to hosted HotCRM follows cloud's v18 framework move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), as triage noted. It sets ordering only.

Dev run: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` (domain:ui seat 1 dispatch, `os-dev`).
